queries: Improve Qualcomm EUD driver and platform support v9

sources.finding: Reset-and-clear-stall sends CLEAR_FEATURE ENDPOINT_HALT and resets the host data toggle. If a device preserves its toggle, first packets can be interpreted as duplicates. Separate reset/clear URBs exist for that case.
sources.limit: The installed selector maps to 0x1e. Documentation plus frame parity supports a candidate; it does not directly measure EUD physical DATA0/1.
sources.supersedes: RX58 session 58.3 and reference/rx58/focused-research.json incorrectly suggested the 0x1e path might not reset host DATA0/1. 0x30 preserves host toggle; 0x1e resets it by specification.

sources.finding: v9 adds UTMI path/PHY/role handling and validates OpenOCD on newer platforms. An October test reply confirms port selection and role switching on Glymur-CRD.
sources.limit: This is upstream qcom_eud hub/control routing, not the SM8150 tty COM driver or a Windows first-frame repair. It provides no new evidence about this retail phone's fuses.
